AI Firm Anthropic Delays IPO to Mid-October Amid Credit Facility Talks

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has shifted its initial public offering (IPO) timeline to mid-October, according to multiple sources. The company was previously expected to release its IPO prospectus as early as the week of September 4. Anthropic is reportedly finalizing a significant $15 billion credit facility and preparing analysts for meetings ahead of the offering. The AI giant is also on track to unveil paperwork for its Wall Street debut, with some reports suggesting a potential $2 trillion valuation. The IPO is expected to test external trust with its governance structure, which includes powerful external trustees.
